<!-- en -->
### Changed
- New installation layout: the binary now lives at `~/.token-usage/bin/token-usage` on macOS and `%USERPROFILE%\.token-usage\bin\token-usage.exe` on Windows, with the bin directory added to your user PATH automatically (macOS: marker block in your shell rc; Windows: type-preserving write to the HKCU `Path` registry value + `WM_SETTINGCHANGE` broadcast). Existing configuration, database and logs are untouched
- The macOS one-line installer now downloads the official Release asset, verifies it against `SHA256SUMS`, installs without sudo, and removes leftover copies from the old layout automatically (manual guidance when not writable)
- README installation sections (English and Chinese) rewritten for the new layout, with a new Uninstall & Migration section
- Binary is identical to rc.12 — this release only changes install scripts and documentation

### Added
- Official Windows installer `scripts/install.ps1` (Windows PowerShell 5.1+; two-step form, SHA256-verified download, upgrade-safe in-place install, legacy WindowsApps symlink/copy residue detection); ARM64 Windows is supported via x64 emulation

<!-- zh -->
### 变更
- 全新安装布局：二进制位于 macOS `~/.token-usage/bin/token-usage`、Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.token-usage\bin\token-usage.exe`，并自动把 bin 目录加入用户 PATH（macOS 写 shell rc 的 marker 块；Windows 保类型写 HKCU `Path` 注册表值并广播 `WM_SETTINGCHANGE`）。既有配置、数据库与日志不受影响
- macOS 一行安装脚本改为下载官方 Release 资产、按 `SHA256SUMS` 校验、免 sudo 安装，并自动清理旧布局遗留副本（不可写时给出手动指引）
- README 双语安装段按新布局重写，新增「卸载与迁移说明」一节
- 二进制与 rc.12 完全相同——本版本仅变更安装脚本与文档

### 新增
- 官方 Windows 安装脚本 `scripts/install.ps1`（兼容 Windows PowerShell 5.1+；两步形态、SHA256 校验、可原位升级的安装、旧 WindowsApps 软链/副本残留检测）；ARM64 Windows 经 x64 仿真支持
